evidence.reason: After edit calls metering.evaluate(units, 0.1, "benchmark") and drops metering.initialize(); the plan string changed from "monthly" to "benchmark" and initialization was removed.
Right edit rebinds evaluate from usageCharge to usageChargeV2, changing the implementation reached by subscriptionCharge's call.
usageQuote calls evaluate(units, multiplier, plan) and is exercised by tests with plan "monthly"; it now routes through usageChargeV2, so any behavior change in V2 affects both callers.
Tests assert evaluate(20, 0.1, "monthly") > 0 and evaluate(-1, 0.1, "monthly") throws RangeError, but no test covers plan "benchmark" or the removed initialize() call.

result.userExplanation: 两处改动叠加后，subscriptionCharge 改用 "benchmark" 计划并去掉了 metering.initialize()，而 evaluate 又被换成 usageChargeV2，现有测试未覆盖这些组合，行为是否仍被依赖无法确定。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/metering.ts 的 usageChargeV2 作者确认其是否支持 "benchmark" 计划且不依赖 initialize()；若不支持，应改回 src/subscription.ts#subscriptionCharge 中的计划字符串为 "monthly" 并恢复 metering.initialize() 调用。
